title: 5 THINGS THAT TEST YOUR FAITH THE MOST
paragraphs: 5 THINGS THAT TEST YOUR FAITH THE MOST

You don’t realize how real your faith is…
until life stops cooperating.

Not when you’re worshipping.
Not when things are working.
But when everything starts breaking.

But here’s what most people don’t realize…
Faith isn’t proven in comfort.
It’s exposed in pressure.
And if this found you, it’s not by accident.
1. Waiting When God Is Silent

You prayed.
You believed.
You expected movement.
But heaven feels quiet.

Days turn into months.
And doubt starts whispering: “Did God forget you?”
Yet Scripture cuts through the silence:
“Wait for the Lord; be strong, and let your heart take courage; wait for the Lord!” — Psalm 27:14
Read that again.

Waiting isn’t punishment.
It’s positioning.

God is not late.
He is precise.
2. Suffering Without Explanation

Pain that doesn’t make sense.
Loss you didn’t deserve.
Storms you didn’t cause.
This is where many walk away.
Because suffering exposes what you really believe about God.
“Though he slay me, I will hope in him…” — Job 13:15

That’s not surface-level faith.
That’s war-tested trust.

Originally written by Gospel Warrior, this truth stands:
Faith that only survives blessings… isn’t faith.
3. Temptation in Your Weakest Moment

Not when you’re strong.
But when you’re tired.
Lonely.
Wounded.
That’s when sin looks reasonable.
That’s when compromise feels justified.
“Each person is tempted when he is lured and enticed by his own desire.” — James 1:14
And then it escalates:
“Then desire when it has conceived gives birth to sin, and sin when it is fully grown brings forth death.” — James 1:15
This is the breaking point.

Because sin doesn’t just test your discipline—
it reveals your allegiance.
4. Obedience When It Costs You Everything

God tells you to walk away.
To forgive.
To surrender something you love.
And it hurts.

Because obedience isn’t always logical.
It’s costly.
“If anyone would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross and follow me.” — Luke 9:23

That’s not a suggestion.
That’s a call to die to self.
But here’s the tension…

What feels like loss…
is actually rescue.
5. Trusting Jesus Alone for Salvation
This is the ultimate test.

Not morality.
Not effort.
Not religion.
But surrender.

Because your instinct says:
“Be good enough.”
But God says:
“For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” — Romans 3:23
And then the turning point:
“But God shows his love for us in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” — Romans 5:8
This is the Gospel.

Sin broke you.
Jesus paid for you.
“For by grace you have been saved through faith… not a result of works.” — Ephesians 2:8-9
Read that again.

You don’t earn salvation.
You receive it.
But here’s the moment everything changes…

When you stop trying to prove yourself—
and start trusting the One who died for you.
Jesus Christ.

Crucified.
Risen.
Calling you.

This is deeper than motivation.
This is eternity.
New teachings are added almost daily.
Now engage:

• Which of these is testing your faith right now?
• SHARE this so others don’t lose their faith in the storm
• FOLLOW the source if you’re serious about growing
Because surface faith won’t survive real battles.
And deeper truth… is waiting.
